svg.title: 4.8.8 octagon-square: acute / median / obtuse
svg.text: After Bonner Fig.123, left column (printed p.255 / PDF 277), 4.8² tessellation. Red dashes = generative tessellation; dots = contact points.
2θ + α = 180° (Kaplan, p.550). Acute octagon uses full {8/3} chords as drawn by Bonner; obtuse octagon degenerates to the midpoint octagon, also as drawn.
